notes.title: Early Access Update 1.6
notes.notes:
Hello agents! This patch includes development changes introduced in June and July.
Functional Changes
Various enhancements to the online chat feature including

Chat text box is now auto focused when you hit enter

Focus remains in chat box after sending a message

Chat disappears after clicking elsewhere on the screen.

The main enemy encountered in the game (Lobster Guy as he has been called) now has a poison orb attack. When a player is hit by this attack they will acquire the poisoned status. This status will sap your health for a few seconds before recovering from the status condition.

Non-boss enemies now have a chance to hide and retreat from combat encounters when they are close to dying. If they successfully retreat, they will call in reinforcements. Be sure to chase down any fleeing enemies!

Only three enemies are ever allowed to run up to the player and perform melee attacks. This prevents players from becoming immobile if enough enemies are in the area trying to melee you.



 
Visual Changes
UI Elements now have custom theming and colors. (These may change in the future)

Add particles to crystals that can be shot to obtain ammo infusions.

Adjusted some keycard scanners that were clipping into their pedestals.

Changed the background color and style of the enemy boss health bars.

 
Bug Fixes
Fixed a bug preventing healing when the warrior's vigor ability is active and an enemy is killed.

 

We have had lots of folks leave the studio/have other things in life take priority over Federation Mycha. For some background, all of us work on Federation Mycha in our free time outside of work, family, and other various commitments in our lives. This change in our staffing has significantly slowed down our development. We will still continue to push out content on our roadmap until we are out of Early Access. We hope to start sharing sneak peeks in our Discord server as new content is ready for feedback. If you want to be one of the first to know about these new changes, hop over there!

notes.title: Early Access Update 1.5
notes.notes:
Hello agents! This patch includes development changes introduced in May. We want to start off with a larger gameplay feature we've been working on!


New Gameplay Feature: Enemy Armor & Gun Infusions!
Weapons can now be loaded with certain Mycha crystals to destroy enemy armor. If you have not picked up a crystal previously for a gun you simply need to walk over it to pick it up. If you already have a crystal in your gun, you will need to interact with it to switch out your existing crystal.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45133124/3ad2e01557ca96c80ac71df0468e4fd28c27073d.png"]

When you have obtained this crystal press Y on your keyboard to toggle usage of your armor penetrating rounds. You will notice your gun gains a pink outline and your weapon icon background will turn pink to indicate how much ammo you have left.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45133124/67bcd7788ab3f44857db6b2bae6d4756869e3d71.png"]

Normal weapon ammo has no effect on armored enemies and requires these new crystals to deal damage until their shield is broken. We have included a visual indicator to the enemy and your hitmarker when you hit an enemy with armor. 

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45133124/184fdd28ba7a30f2c3fb015b36c886e706df7bba.png"]
Additionally there is a large visual effect with sound cues when the shield is broken (see blue particles in the screenshot below).

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45133124/f3ce4ba7feb9518f5c83131bd48ac73593966c36.png"]
For now, this new feature is limited to the desert boss but will be incorporated into new levels and the tutorial in a later update closer to full release.

Here's the other changes we have added with our dev work in May:
Functional Changes
Desert level boss encounter has been reworked to use the new shield ammo & has new phases

Bosses now have health bars at the top of the player's HUD. 
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45133124/216da9628f8dbe8634b3104c275d319be8bc4a2b.png"]

Lucas's heal beacon ability has been reworked to use a new asset and has animations. (We have plans to make this ability a throwable orb that expands on impact with the ground which will be enabled in a future update once some bugs are fixed.)

 
Visual Changes
 Fixed large visual effects on the Crystalink which would move around the entire lobby area. 

 Captain Dean's Warrior Spirit texture has changed to appear more ghostly.

 
Bug Fixes
Player companions (Warrior's Spirit and skeletons) will now prioritize enemies actively attacking the player that spawned them over other enemies.

 
Miscellaneous Changes
Various gameplay elements are properly synced in multiplayer mode.

Added French to the list of supported languages (UI and subtitles, no voices are translated)

Please continue to provide us feedback about what you like and don't like on the community forums and Discord. The best way to interact directly with the entire team and influence the development of the game is to join our Discord!  That's all we have for now! Stay tuned for some of the new levels we're hoping to release later this year! The shield ammo section features some early prototype areas of our new desert level

notes.title: Early Access Update 1.4
notes.notes:
Hello agents! This patch includes development changes introduced in March/April. These are mainly smaller changes while we work on new levels and gameplay in the background. We hope to start sharing sneak peeks soon on our Discord!

Functional Changes

 Objectives have new animations and sound effects for polishing.
 Most doors (excluding tutorial level) no longer block when dialogue is playing.
 Players now take fall damage when falling from significant heights.
 Player movement speed has been reduced (Walk: 6m/s => 4 m/s, Run 10 m/s => 7 m/s, Crouch 2.5 m/s => 2 m/s, Downed 1.5 m/s => 1 m/s)
 Elevator moves slightly faster


Visual Changes

 Fixed large visual effects on the Crystalink which would move around the entire lobby area.
 Crosshair now properly centered on screen.
 Fixed an issue where the character select in the pause menu wasn't sensing the player's mouse.
 Key items now have more noticable visual effects.
 Enemy outlines (for bosses and item holders) no longer tear from their character model.
 Lighting adjustments made in the desert mission to make building interiors more visible.


Bug Fixes

 Missing HUD subtitles no longer show a single colon on the screen.
 Fixed a bug preventing the game from pausing in single player.
 Low health sound now resets when completing a level
 Captain Dean's Warrior Spirit can no longer spawn out of bounds on the other side of walls.
 Fixed sound effects on overhead fluorescent lights in the desert mission.
 Fixed a bug preventing Lucas's heal beacon from working outside the tutorial level.


Miscellaneous Changes

 Lots of Localization infrastructure has been added! If you are interested in helping us translate the game into your native language please let us know! We'd be happy to work with you.


Please continue to provide us feedback about what you like and don't like on the community forums and Discord. The best way to interact directly with the entire team and influence the development of the game is to join our Discord!

That's all we have for now! Stay tuned for some of the new levels we're working on!

notes.title: Early Access Build 1.2 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Hello agents! This patch includes development changes introduced in February. Full details are described below. Please reach out to us directly on our Discord if you have any suggestions or new issues that we didn't find during our testing!

Functional Changes

 Added a few instances of new hazards in the desert mission: Mycha tornadoes, damaged servers and frayed wires
 Added crouching to the game. Pressing and holding left control will cause your player to crouch.
 Enemies will now react to the sounds of player footsteps and follow the sounds if heard.
 Enemy vision is decreased in dark or dim areas.
 Enemy health scales with the amount of players in the game.


Visual Changes

 Added flare beams or ghost light VFX to interactable items to help distinguish them from the environment.
 Added new desert sand particle effects in the desert mission.
 Added sand colored fog in the desert mission


Bug Fixes

 Fixed a huge performance issue in the tutorial's boss fight when the boss summons allies. Frame drops should no longer occur in these instances.
 Fixed the Shotgun's hitmarker logic allowing it to consider multiple enemies to determine the effect shown. If one enemy shot is killed, the kill marker is shown. If no enemies died and one with a shield is hit, the shield hitmarker is shown. Otherwise, the standard hitmarker is shown.
 Fixed collision on the green keycard in the tutorial level clipping through room geometry.


Miscellaneous Changes

 Updated footstep sounds for agents


... And lots more behind the scenes we're hoping to share in an update coming soon!


Please continue to provide us feedback about what you like and don't like on the community forums and Discord. The best way to interact directly with the entire team and influence the development of the game is to join our Discord!

That's all we have for now! Stay tuned for what we have in the pipeline!

notes.title: Early Access Build 1.1 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Hello agents! It's been awhile since our last update, but now that holidays are over we plan to continue pushing out updates monthly. We are currently working on some new content but want to make sure we release it in a much better state than Desert Clifftops was in when we launched in early access. The full details for this patch are below:

Functional Changes

 Weapon selection UI has been revamped! Agents can now view their weapon stats while choosing weapons and compare them when changing to new weapons.
 Multiplayer Server Creation UI uses checkboxes for server settings and now provides hover tooltips to explain each setting
 Boss Mychalytes besides the tutorial boss now reward players with Mycha shards after defeating them.
 Mychalyte movement speeds have been reduced for smaller instances.
 Agent voicelines have been temporarily removed from the Desert Clifftops (we're polishing these up now and plan to add them in one of the upcoming updates)


Bug Fixes

 Desert Clifftop buttons are now interactable allowing agents to investigate all of the Desert Clifftop base and the bunker.
 Key Items dropped by enemies are no longer scaled based on the enemy that dropped them.


Miscellaneous Changes

 Updated footstep sounds for agents and Mychalytes
 Removed overhead lighting in the Federation building lobby
 Boss Mychalyte in Desert Clifftops has updated textures
 Credits have been updated to include new developers on the game since our last patch


... And lots more behind the scenes!


Please continue to provide us feedback about what you like and don't like on the community forums and Discord. The best way to interact directly with the entire team and influence the development of the game is to join our Discord!

That's all we have for now! Stay tuned for what we have in the pipeline!

notes.title: Important Bug Fixes Patch Notes(version EA 1.0.1)
notes.notes:
Hello agents! 

Shortly after our initial Early Access launch we noticed some important issues preventing progression through the tutorial and desert clifftop mission. The full details can be found below:


- Fixed a bug where enemies could stand on top of bullet boost magazine pickups
- Fixed a bug where an agent in the tutorial combat zone could get stuck in a door while it's closing
- Fixed a bug where the Crystalink start/end transmission sound would play twice in some scenarios
- Fixed a bug causing the desert clifftop's security monitor screen's interact UI to always be invisible
- Fixed a bug where the [spoiler]Cerberus[/spoiler] (desert clifftop mutated mychalyte) was defeatable with one bullet
- Desert wind particles no longer spawn inside the green facility building in the desert clifftops
- Temporarily removed Captain Dean voicelines from desert clifftop's buttons (we're working on something to make this choose a character in the party to say something)

notes.title: Important Bug Fixes Inbound
notes.notes:
Hello Agents!

We're aware of a couple larger bugs that have creeped up in our initial release patch (mainly with the desert clifftops mission). We are hard at work fixing these issues and should have an update out later this week to address them.

If you haven't already, please take advantage of our community Discord Server to communicate any issues you've experienced with the game or to share ideas you have for the game!
